FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: BOJ Hawkish Shift and Strong PMI Signal JPY Strength
tldr_points: Japanese factory PMI shows strongest growth since February, supporting JPY strength.
BOJ expected to hike rates to 1.25% in September as inflation broadens.
USD/JPY trades below MA20 (159.70) with RSI at 63, indicating near-term bearish bias.
FX.excerpt: Japan PMI spikes, BOJ signals Sept hike, boosting JPY and dragging USD/JPY lower despite mild USD resilience worldwides.
FX.comment: BOJ hawkish outlook and strong PMI data point to JPY appreciation, driving USD/JPY lower.
